descriptions.introduction: Self-host Hyvor Blogs on your own servers. Minimal dependencies, Docker-based deployment, OIDC authentication, and full control of your blogging platform.
descriptions.deploy: Deploy self-hosted Hyvor Blogs with Docker Compose. Step-by-step guide covering prerequisites, PostgreSQL, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and starting the app.
descriptions.reverseProxy: Configure a reverse proxy for self-hosted Hyvor Blogs with Traefik, Caddy, or NGINX. Handle the app domain and custom domains with automatic HTTPS.
descriptions.env: All environment variables for self-hosted Hyvor Blogs: app secret, PostgreSQL database URL, domains, OIDC, mail, and storage configuration reference.
descriptions.deliveryDomain: Serve self-hosted Hyvor Blogs from subdomains with a delivery domain. Learn why and how to configure DNS and wildcard SSL for blog subdomains.
